Title: R-34: Cari pertanyaan MBTI from correct source
Description:
**Summary**

* Implemented OJTS v2.1 session-based personality testing.
* Added psychometric analysis with Cronbach’s alpha.
* Schemas for sessions, responses, and scoring tables.
* 34-question bilingual OJTS set with strict ID validation.
* Guardrails for mismatched IDs and duplicate/corrupt responses.

**System refactor**

* Upgraded to Next.js 15 with async params handling.
* Server-side data fetching with caching for dashboard flows.
* Converted suitable components to server components.
* Modularized personality metrics with URL state management.
* i18n coverage across dashboard and join-class flow.

**Quality and ops**

* Removed deprecated auth and unused UI utilities.
* Improved tests, added Knip config, cleaned Biome rules and deps.

**Why this closes R-34**

* Questions sourced from the correct OJTS v2.1 set.
* Bilingual delivery supported and validated at schema level.
* End-to-end from session to scoring implemented and tested.

**Link**
PR: [https://github.com/deymosxdeymos/eduteams/pull/22](https://github.com/deymosxdeymos/eduteams/pull/22)

**Follow-ups**

* Monitor Cronbach’s alpha on first 200 runs and set threshold alerts.
* Admin export for session-level scores.
* Document question-set versioning policy in the repo.
